name: Outbound Call Without Timeout
attack_scenario: an outbound call with no timeout hangs forever if the remote is slow or malicious, exhausting connections/threads and taking the service down (a resource-exhaustion DoS)
negative_test_hint: point the call at a "black-hole server" that accepts but never answers and assert the call aborts within a bounded time

exemplar.explanation: always set an explicit timeout on outbound network calls so a slow/hostile peer cannot hang the service
